topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: When I stumbled upon my college application essay, not just tucked away in a dusty folder, but prominently featured as an example for aspiring students, I couldn’t help but linger on the page a bit longer than necessary. The words, meticulously crafted and laboriously polished, still resonated with the same vigor and passion as they did when I first penned them. It was clear that the effort had not gone unnoticed. The thought that my work could now guide and perhaps inspire others, well, let’s just say it adds a certain layer of significance to what was once just another hurdle on the path to higher education.
